exploitation.payload: Multiple GET/POST requests to /rest/codingChallenges with varied pattern query values (empty, *, (a+)+$, whitespace-encoded variants, POST body with repeated patterns)
exploitation.response: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error; HTML error page includes stack trace and 'OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.21.0)' with file paths
exploitation.proof: Stack trace disclosure and files paths indicate information disclosure; no ReDoS timing proof. Responses show server version and file system paths in error page.

remediation: Validate and limit regex complexity; catch exceptions and return generic errors; disable stack trace exposure in production.
